working_tree: main, uncommitted; earlier completed priorities preserved
scope: Complete N3 recursive-aggregation metadata stage, no recursive proof generation or runtime preissue

implementation.field_hash: Eight-lane sequential Poseidon, one stream per workgroup; immutable NVIDIA capability selection; scalar GPU fallback for unsupported shapes/devices
implementation.field_hash_framing: Same initial state, rate-four padding, canonicalization after each permutation, ordered 4096-word tiles, 64 streams / 131072 packed words
implementation.field_hash_failures: Collective canonical validation; execution errors poison the scope with no retry; existing scrub/fence path
implementation.encoding: Fixed four-word expression buffer, reused node/operation scratch, admitted shape capacity upper bound, 8192-byte LE-u64 hash buffering
implementation.encoding_framing: Flush before witness-only roots and finalization; exact registration words and both domain-separated inventory hashes unchanged
implementation.verifier_keys: Exact typed descriptor, family, native numeric source fingerprint and profile
implementation.verifier_scope: Successful closed numeric plans only; original source checks, reservations, runtime recording and same_census checks remain
implementation.verifier_overflow: Uncached admitted recording; no eviction or failed result retention
implementation.memory: Inline case cache and construction/lookup frames, encoder buffer and profiling counters included before admission; existing limits unchanged
implementation.previous_optimizations: All previous hash and reuse optimizations enabled in every comparison and ablation

limits.gpu_metadata_compiler_port: Deferred; raw field hashing optimized on GPU, numeric metadata compilation remains on CPU

methodology.phase_medians: computed independently, may not sum to total median
methodology.fixtures: same captured and independently verified public inputs replayed by both versions
methodology.interpretation: metadata wall latency, not RingCT transaction creation or proof throughput; cache rates are software descriptor-cache rates

diagnostic_methodology: One fresh-process instrumented sample per variant, all previous hash optimizations enabled. Effects overlap and are not additive.
